ideas.title: Cabbage and Carrot Slaw with Avocado
ideas.blurb: This refreshing slaw uses up the red cabbage and carrots, topped with creamy avocado.

recipe.description: This vibrant Cabbage and Carrot Slaw with Avocado is a refreshing dish that combines crunchy vegetables with creamy avocado. Perfect as a side or a light meal, it's easy to prepare and packed with nutrients.
ingredients: 30g fresh herbs (e.g., cilantro or parsley), chopped
steps: In a large bowl, combine the shredded red cabbage and grated carrots.
Add the diced avocado and gently mix to combine.
Squeeze the juice of one lime over the mixture and toss gently to coat.
Add the sliced cucumber, radish, and diced green bell pepper.
Sprinkle chopped fresh herbs over the top and season with salt to taste.
Toss everything together until well mixed and serve immediately.

ideas.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
ideas.blurb: A quick stir-fry that highlights your fresh veggies like broccoli, bell pepper, and spinach.

recipe.description: This Vegetable Stir-Fry showcases fresh broccoli, green bell pepper, and spinach for a quick and healthy meal. It's a vibrant dish packed with nutrients and flavors, perfect for a busy weeknight dinner.
steps: Wash and chop the broccoli into small florets.
Slice the green bell pepper into thin strips.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat (about 2 minutes).
Add the broccoli florets and green bell pepper strips to the pan and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the grated ginger and stir for another minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach and soy sauce, and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.

ideas.title: Stuffed Cucumber Boats
ideas.blurb: Cucumber boats filled with a mix of tomato, radish, and herbs make a light and crunchy dinner.

recipe.description: Stuffed cucumber boats are a refreshing and light meal, perfect for warm weather. Filled with a vibrant mix of tomato, radish, and fresh herbs, they are both crunchy and satisfying.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh herbs (e.g., parsley or dill), chopped
steps: Slice the cucumbers in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds to create boats.
In a bowl, mix the diced tomatoes, sliced radish, and cream cheese or hummus until well combined.
Add the chopped fresh herbs to the mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Fill each cucumber boat with the tomato and radish mixture, pressing down gently to pack it in.
Serve immediately as a light dinner or snack.

ideas.title: Roasted Vegetable Medley
ideas.blurb: A hearty medley of roasted carrots, broccoli, and bell pepper, perfect for a comforting dinner.

recipe.description: This Roasted Vegetable Medley features a delightful combination of carrots, broccoli, and green bell pepper, all roasted to perfection. It's a simple yet satisfying dish that can be enjoyed as a side or a main course.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Wash and peel the carrots, then cut them into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the broccoli and cut it into florets.
Wash the green bell pepper, remove the seeds, and cut it into strips.
In a large bowl, combine the carrots, broccoli, and green bell pepper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
Toss the vegetables until they are evenly coated with oil and seasoning.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized, stirring halfway through.

ideas.title: Spinach and Tomato Salad
ideas.blurb: A simple salad that combines fresh spinach with tomato, cucumber, and a light dressing.

recipe.description: This refreshing Spinach and Tomato Salad features fresh spinach, juicy tomatoes, and crisp cucumber, topped with feta cheese for added flavor. It's a quick and healthy dish perfect for any meal.
steps: Wash the fresh spinach under cold water and dry it with a salad spinner or kitchen towel.
Slice the tomatoes into thin slices and set aside.
Slice the cucumber into rounds and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, sliced tomatoes, and cucumber.
Crumble the feta cheese over the salad mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper to create the dressing.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine all ingredients evenly.
Serve immediately for the best freshness.
